hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve Uniswap v4 hook that routes all swap liquidity through Euler Finance EVK vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes quotes via a proprietary curve invariant (CurveLib), takes input tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another Euler vault, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta — fully handling swap execution outside Uniswap's native concentrated liquidity.
